implementation_details.workspace_fence: Binding additionally stores immutable workspace_token+workspace_generation, both included in its full immutable binding digest. Ordered principal->project guard->membership NOWAIT->job->binding->workspace intent SHARE->outbox locks prevent validated READY identity changing before projection commit. G5 locks only intent and does not acquire earlier classes.
implementation_details.workspace_recovery: ERROR/RESERVED/PROVISIONING are wait and never apply. A READY intent recovered with a changed generation after binding reservation is an identity conflict and quarantines without relinking or projection. Same committed receipt replays before any later workspace/revocation checks. Automatic binding migration/unquarantine is not implemented or accepted; explicit future operator recovery contract is required.
implementation_details.command_bytes: G4 persists canonical ASCII command JSON; hash the fixed original format/payload envelope over exact immutable stored bytes. Use PostgreSQL json for safe project/profile extraction and avoid decoding free request text through jsonb because escaped U+0000 is legal at existing ingress. New NUL/Unicode fixture exercises actual G4 accepted bytes; no raw body enters Temporal.

configuration_hash_domains.encoding: SHA256(UTF8 domain + NUL + Python ASCII sorted compact integer-only JSON), protocol_version h2-v1. Independent TC fixed literals assert both hashes. Actual worker/launcher source/environment/endpoint checks remain future runtime evidence; registry hash alone is not attestation.

implementation_details.null_constraints: Explicit non-NULL applied revision/rejected code and start-window all-or-none checks. TC must distinguish CHECK command_outcome_shape from immutable-terminal trigger by using initially accepted separate rows.
